status.label: Questionable
status.shortComment: Olave (hamstring) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game at Baltimore, Nick Underhill of NewOrleans.Football reports.
status.longComment: When Olave went down as a limited participant at Thursday's practice due to a hamstring injury, his early exit was deemed precautionary, according to Underhill. Olave remained limited Friday and thus will enter the weekend as a question mark for the Saints' Week 2 offense. In a Week 1 loss at Detroit, Olave served as Tyler Shough's top pass catcher to the tune of 10 catches for 182 yards on 13 targets.

status.label: Questionable
status.shortComment: Miller (toe) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game versus Baltimore.
status.longComment: Miller missed a few practices during the week but practiced in a limited capacity Friday, though it wasn't enough to avoid a questionable designation. If Miller can't suit up for the Week 2 clash with Baltimore, Khristian Boyd and John Ridgeway may need to be involved.

status.label: Questionable
status.shortComment: Young (calf) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against Baltimore.
status.longComment: Despite logging 59 defensive snaps in the 31-30 overtime loss to the Lions in Week 1, Young didn't record a tackle. He was limited during practice throughout the week, so if he can't suit up versus the Ravens, Tyree Wilson and Anfernee Jennings could be more involved.
